description:
Design and develop an AI-driven platform for automatically analyzing IPsec VPN deployments under different security configurations. The platform should analyze captured traffic or live network streams, identify IPsec and IKE characteristics, infer Tunnel or Transport mode, identify encryption, authentication and key-exchange configurations, and assess the overall security posture.

The solution should support a VPN testbed with configurations such as AES-128/256, AES-GCM, AES-CBC + HMAC, different DH groups, PFS enabled/disabled, IPv4/IPv6 and different traffic types. It should capture IKE, ESP, optional AH and normal communication traffic, use AI to identify protocol and Security Association characteristics, infer traffic types inside ESP, and evaluate cryptographic strength, compliance, key lifetime, replay protection, PFS, cipher strength and metadata exposure.

The platform should generate comprehensive security assessments including risk scoring, threat matrices, AI confidence scores, traffic analysis, metadata inference, and executive/technical reports through an interactive dashboard.

description:
Develop a comprehensive Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) analytics platform to support organizations in preparing for the transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). The tool should discover and catalogue cryptographic artefacts—including algorithms, keys, certificates, protocols, libraries, hardware modules and cloud services—across internal and externally facing applications, products and infrastructure.

The platform should perform quantum risk assessment to identify systems potentially vulnerable to quantum attacks and highlight risks to sensitive data. It should classify cryptographic artefacts based on type, lifetime and business criticality, and apply structured risk frameworks such as Mosca's algorithm by comparing data lifetime and migration time against the expected arrival of cryptographically relevant quantum computers.

Based on the identified risk profile, the tool should recommend suitable PQC or hybrid cryptographic alternatives considering factors such as risk, latency and cost.

description:
Develop an extensible, model-agnostic computer-vision assurance framework capable of evaluating the integrity and security of contributed training datasets, trained models and inference records. The system should provide evidence-based assessments without assuming that every contributing data or model source is trusted.

The solution should identify suspicious training-data behaviour including trigger injection, label flipping, systematic mislabelling, near-duplicate flooding and out-of-distribution insertion, while aggregating available contributor, batch or source metadata into source-level risk assessments. It should assess model integrity for anomalous, substituted or backdoor-like behaviour using appropriate techniques based on the available access level, while clearly reporting assumptions, confidence and limitations.

The platform should create verifiable cryptographic provenance linking input images, model identifiers or weight digests, preprocessing and inference configurations, and generated outputs. It should make post-hoc alteration, substitution or replay of protected inference records detectable using hashes, signatures and suitable sequence, timestamp or nonce controls.

The framework should also detect distribution shifts caused by terrain, season, sensor, illumination or acquisition conditions, distinguish operational drift from suspicious manipulation where evidence permits, and provide calibrated risk or confidence scores. Every finding should include a human-readable reason, supporting evidence, confidence or severity, affected asset and recommended disposition such as accept, review or quarantine.

The complete evaluation workflow must operate offline in an air-gapped environment, support common dataset formats such as COCO and YOLO and organiser-defined model formats including ONNX and PyTorch/TorchScript. White-box assessment methods should gracefully fall back or clearly report unavailable assessments when only black-box access is provided.
industry: Cybersecurity / Artificial Intelligence / Computer Vision Security

Detection of label flipping and systematic mislabelling
Inference provenance and cryptographic integrity protection
Detection of inference-record alteration, substitution and replay
Analyst dashboard with accept, review and quarantine recommendations
Support for COCO, YOLO, ONNX and PyTorch/TorchScript formats
Reproducible poisoning, backdoor, substitution and tampering test scenarios
Coverage statement identifying supported attack classes, assumptions and limitations
